name: Altech CBI12xx DC UPS
summary: CBI12xx UPS interface layout for backed-up DC control power.
description: The manufacturer index maps drawing group CBI12xx to CBI123A, CBI126A, CBI1210A, CBI1235A. Reserve separate routes for supply, battery and backed-up load conductors; the battery is not included in the device outline.
Use the linked manufacturer mechanical original for dimensions and exact revision. This illustration is independently drawn, unitless and not to scale.
readingNotes: Reserve separate supply, battery and backed-up load wiring routes.
The device envelope does not include an external battery or establish battery compatibility, protection requirements or backup duration.
